title: Enemy skill that makes user decrease in Max HP

posts.author: bigsloppa122
posts.body:
Hi, I use RPG Maker MZ and I was trying to make a skill that was used by an
enemy
that decreased its maximum HP by
5
. I know there are ways to
grow
its max HP, but I don't know how to
lower
it's max HP through a skill. If you can help me in any way please reply, thanks.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
You would lower HP in the same way you increase it, but with negative values.
The Change Enemy HP event command has radio buttons for you to select whether you want to increase or decrease.

posts.author: Canned_Dinosaur
posts.body:
You want to decrease the user's
Max
HP by a flat amount of 5...? Perhaps if you add the following to the damage formula (untested:
a.addParam(0, -5);
So if your damage formula is a.atk - b.def:
a.addParam(0, -5); a.atk - b.def
